Consolidate repeated audit/cache prose into one compact latest-turn decision sequence: identify each changed domain and constraint; use only an exact listed compatible cache result for refinement; search only when no compatible result exists and required inputs are available; leave unaffected domains alone. Prioritize minimal executable tool code: no imports of presumed modules, invented cache keys, guessed result fields, or speculative result rendering. Bind and save exact tool returns. Add schema edits only for recurring concrete misses: preserve literal enum/code values (for example, AN rather than AA), distinguish state from city, and reject unsupported arguments.
